# MSNCB - Medical-Surgical Nursing Certification Board

> MSNCB administers nursing certifications (CMSRN and CAVRN) with exam scheduling, recertification, and credential verification services.

The Medical-Surgical Nursing Certification Board (MSNCB) is a professional organization offering specialized nursing certifications for medical-surgical nurses and virtual acute-care nurses. The site provides comprehensive resources for exam preparation, certification management, and professional recognition.

## Key Topics

- CMSRN Certification
- CAVRN Certification
- Exam Scheduling & Fees
- Recertification Requirements
- Credential Verification
- Exam Blueprint
- Eligibility Requirements
- Study Resources
- Pearson VUE Testing
- Contact Hours
- Certification Portal
- Payment Methods
- Nursing Credentials
- Medical-Surgical Nursing
- Virtual Acute-Care Nursing

## CMSRN Certification

- [CMSRN Certification](https://www.msncb.org/CMSRN/Certification): CMSRN certification overview: eligibility, exam blueprint, and requirements
- [Exam Processes, Scheduling, and Fees](https://www.msncb.org/CMSRN/Exam-Processes-Scheduling-and-Fees): CMSRN exam scheduling, fees, registration, and testing policies
- [CMSRN Recertification](https://www.msncb.org/CMSRN/Recertification): CMSRN recertification options: contact hours, exam, and renewal process
- [CMSRN Resources](https://www.msncb.org/CMSRN/Resources): CMSRN study guides, exam blueprints, and certification preparation resources
- [Verify a Certification](https://www.msncb.org/CMSRN/Verify-a-Certification): CMSRN credential verification lookup tool for employers and verification
- [Update Your Status](https://www.msncb.org/CMSRN/Update-Your-Status): Update CMSRN certification status: name, license, and employment changes
- [CertAssure](https://www.msncb.org/CMSRN/CertAssure): CertAssure financial protection product for CMSRN exam retake coverage

## CAVRN Certification

- [CAVRN Certification](https://www.msncb.org/CAVRN/Certification): CAVRN certification for virtual acute-care nurses: eligibility and domains
- [Exam Processes, Scheduling, and Fees](https://www.msncb.org/CAVRN/Exam-Processes-Scheduling-and-Fees): CAVRN exam scheduling, fees, registration, and testing procedures
- [CAVRN Recertification](https://www.msncb.org/CAVRN/Recertification): CAVRN recertification: contact hours, exam options, and renewal requirements
- [CAVRN Resources](https://www.msncb.org/CAVRN/Resources): CAVRN study guides, practice exams, and certification preparation materials

## About MSNCB

- [About MSNCB](https://www.msncb.org/About/About-MSNCB): Medical-Surgical Nursing Certification Board mission and organizational overview
- [Board of Directors](https://www.msncb.org/About/Board-of-Directors): MSNCB Board of Directors leadership and organizational governance
- [Grants & Awards](https://www.msncb.org/About/Grants-Awards): MSNCB grants and awards programs recognizing nursing excellence
- [Statistics](https://www.msncb.org/About/Statistics): MSNCB certification statistics, pass rates, and exam performance data
- [Contact Us](https://www.msncb.org/About/Contact-Us): MSNCB contact information and staff directory for certification support
